name: abosefen-demo
description: Live demo of a real sanitaryware shop system (storefront + back office, Arabic-first, ar/en/de) — with case studies of the .NET microservices behind it.

paragraphs: A standalone, public demo of the Abosefen system — the online shop and back office of an Egyptian sanitaryware store (pipes and fittings, valves, mixers, showers, sanitary ceramics, kitchen sinks, accessories).

It runs entirely in the browser: no server, no database, no account to create. Every product, brand, price, stock figure, order and person in it is synthetic. Nothing you do here is real — no payment is taken, no message is sent, and every change stays in your own browser until you press Reset demo.
Live demo: antoniousshehata.github.io/abosefen-demo — opens in English; switch to German from the header.
